events.headline: See more of your spending in one place
events.summary: Personal customers can now link credit cards from other banks and ask Mercury Command about their spending across all of them.

events.headline: Agent Controls: let agents take on financial work without handing over the keys
events.summary: Business customers can see every connected AI agent, its permissions and its activity, and set rules the agent must follow.

events.headline: Treasury, reinvented
events.summary: Treasury has been redesigned. It builds a portfolio based on monthly expenses and offers U.S. Treasury ladders, and accounts need $250K+ in balances to qualify.

events.headline: Introducing Mercury Payroll
events.summary: Mercury launched payroll for W-2 and 1099 workers, with health benefits, 401(k) and compliance support, in all 50 states.

events.headline: Mercury crosses $1B in annualized revenue and 450,000+ customers
events.summary: In a Newcomer interview, CEO Immad Akhund said Mercury has reached $1B in annualized run-rate revenue (as_of 2026-10-19), growing about 50% year over year, with more than 450,000 customers. This comes from secondary coverage, not a Mercury announcement.

events.headline: Apply for a Mercury account with a pending EIN
events.summary: Businesses can apply with a completed Form SS-4 while their EIN is pending, then have 90 days after approval to provide it.

events.headline: Take action on your Mercury account from ChatGPT and Claude
events.summary: Customers can connect Mercury to ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay recipients or categorize transactions, and each action needs the user's approval first.

events.headline: Priority Support now available for Plus and Pro customers
events.summary: Plus and Pro subscribers now get faster support as a plan benefit. All customers keep 24/7 access.

events.headline: All your accounts, connected
events.summary: Customers can link multiple Mercury accounts for quick transfers, set up automatic transfer rules and schedule recurring sends to outside bank accounts.

events.headline: Send real-time payments with the Mercury API
events.summary: The API can now send real-time payments that arrive within seconds at any time, for accounts provided through Column, N.A.

events.headline: Authorize wire drawdowns for payroll
events.summary: Customers can let payroll providers such as Sequoia and Gusto withdraw funds directly by wire drawdown, for accounts through Column, N.A. and Choice Financial Group.
